summary: I18N-RECOVERY-001 full-stack testing. Backend P0-A (locale fields on 3 AI endpoints) all pass. Frontend P0-C, P1 pages pass. One HIGH bug found: LocaleSwitcher dropdown shows only 1 locale (EN-US) because DB stores Italian as 'it-IT' but BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES has 'it' (strict mismatch → Italian filtered out). P0-B es-MX is in static JS files but NOT in DB and not shown in any UI (blueprint_enabled:false by design, but test expected visibility).

minor.issue: Only returns 2 languages (it-IT, en-US). DB platform_languages table missing en-GB, fr, de, es. Pre-existing DB state issue.

supported list does not include ES_MX: ['IT_IT','EN_US','EN_GB','EN_AE','DE_DE','FR_FR','ES_ES']. Backend reads from DB, not from frontend static LocaleRuntimeContext. P0-B only updated frontend JS, not backend DB.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown shows only 1 locale (English US). Italian and all other operational locales are absent. Root cause: DB stores Italian as code 'it-IT', but BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES (languages.js:54) has 'it'. blueprintLanguages() uses BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.includes(l.code) (strict match). 'it-IT' !== 'it' → Italian filtered out. DB bootstrap (bootstrapLanguagesFromDB) overrides static LANGUAGE_REGISTRY with DB codes. Since DB only has 2 entries (it-IT, en-US) and it-IT fails the filter, only en-US shows.

es-MX not visible in LocaleSwitcher dropdown or admin language settings (/admin/languages). es-MX was added to static LANGUAGE_REGISTRY (blueprint_enabled: false) and LocaleRuntimeContext but NOT to DB platform_languages table and NOT to BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES. Admin /admin/languages shows only it-IT and en-US from DB. es-MX comment in BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES is present but the value is NOT in the array (lines 53-55 show only 6 codes, es-MX excluded).

integration_issues.issue: bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() overwrites static LANGUAGE_REGISTRY with DB data. DB has it-IT vs. static registry 'it'. blueprintLanguages() strict code match causes Italian to disappear from dropdown. Fix: either normalize DB codes in bootstrap OR update blueprintLanguages() filter to do base-code matching (e.g. BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.some(c => l.code === c || l.code.startsWith(c+'-'))).

action_items: HIGH: Fix blueprintLanguages() filter in languages.js to handle base-code matching. Current: BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.includes(l.code). Proposed: BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.some(c => l.code === c || l.code.startsWith(c + '-')). This would match 'it-IT' against 'it' and allow Italian to appear in LocaleSwitcher.
MEDIUM: Update DB platform_languages to include all 6 Blueprint operational languages (en-GB, fr, de, es, and use 'it' not 'it-IT' as code). Currently only it-IT and en-US are in DB.

MEDIUM: P0-B es-MX visibility - if es-MX should be visible somewhere in Blueprint UI (e.g., admin languages settings), add it to DB platform_languages table. If it's purely public site/client companion, update test expectations and documentation.

INFO: The backend /api/locale-runtime/resolve does not return ES_MX in supported list (reads from DB). If P0-B requires backend awareness of es-MX, update the locale-runtime-context configuration in the database.
critical_code_review_comments: languages.js:190-192 - blueprintLanguages() strict BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.includes(l.code) fails when DB uses 'it-IT' vs static registry 'it'. Should use base-code matching.

languages.js:114-153 - bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() sets _dbMirror directly from DB response codes (it-IT) without normalizing to match BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES. The DB codes and operational codes are inconsistent.

BlueprintContext.jsx:25 - FALLBACK_LOCALES computed at module load time. If localStorage DB cache already has it-IT data, FALLBACK_LOCALES will be just [en-US] on first render. This could cause a brief empty-locale state.

The comment in BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES (languages.js:51) says 'es-MX → es-MX ← P0-B I18N-RECOVERY-001' but es-MX is NOT added to the array (line 54 only has 6 codes). Either the comment is misleading or es-MX was meant to be added but wasn't.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: DB platform_languages table stores Italian code as 'it-IT'. bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() sets _dbMirror = [{code:'it-IT',...},{code:'en-US',...}]. blueprintLanguages() filters with BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.includes(l.code) where BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES=['it','en-US','en-GB','fr','de','es']. 'it-IT' is NOT in this array → Italian filtered out. Only 'en-US' passes → 1 locale in dropdown.
rca_of_issue.mitigation: In languages.js line 191, change strict includes to: BLUEPRINT_OPERATIONAL_CODES.some(c => l.code === c || l.code.startsWith(c + '-')). This would match 'it-IT' against operational code 'it' via prefix check.
